# Psalm 8 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 8:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For-the-choirmaster. Upon the-Gittith. A-psalm of-David.
- **LOGOS:** For the choirmaster. According to the Gittith. A psalm of David.
- **PNEUMA:** For the music director. To be accompanied on an instrument from Gath. A psalm of David.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 8:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** From-the-mouth of-infants and-nurslings You-have-established strength, because-of Your-adversaries, to-silence the-enemy and-the-avenger.
- **LOGOS:** Out of the mouth of infants and nursing babes You have established strength, because of Your foes, to still the enemy and the avenger.
- **PNEUMA:** You have taught children and infants to give You praise. By their praise You silence Your enemies and put an end to the avenger.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 8:6 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** And-You-made-him-lack a-little from-God [elohim], and-with-glory and-honor You-crown-him.
- **LOGOS:** Yet You have made him a little lower than the heavenly beings and crowned him with glory and honor.
- **PNEUMA:** Yet You made them only a little lower than God and crowned them with glory and honor.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 8:8 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** sheep and-cattle, all-of-them, and-also the-beasts of-the-field,
- **LOGOS:** all sheep and oxen, and also the beasts of the field,
- **PNEUMA:** the flocks and herds, and all the wild animals,

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 8:9 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** the-birds of-the-heavens and-the-fish of-the-sea, passing-through the-paths of-the-seas.
- **LOGOS:** the birds of the heavens, and the fish of the sea, whatever passes along the paths of the seas.
- **PNEUMA:** the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and everything that swims the ocean currents.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 8:4 (overlap: 5%)

- **EMET:** When I-see Your-heavens, the-work of-Your-fingers, the-moon and-the-stars which You-have-established —
- **LOGOS:** When I consider Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place —
- **PNEUMA:** When I look at the night sky and see the work of Your fingers — the moon and the stars You have set in place —

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
